platform: Linux x86_64; native headless lab and Xvfb benchmarks
scope: Simulation, native input, presentation and asset validation. Mac sound/display and human feel/balance require device playtesting.

rocket.defects_found: Generic flight/blast feedback lacked a distinct rocket presentation.
rocket.changes: Dedicated heading-aligned rocket, motor trail, warm burst and bounded shake.

mortar.defects_found: Secondary fragments reused the shell silhouette; legacy fragment tracks lost their identity.
mortar.changes: Separate small fragments, inherited horizontal momentum and boosted damage; restore legacy fragment metadata.

homing.defects_found: Motor ignition/burnout was not reflected in the projectile art.
homing.changes: Coasting/powered sprites and motor trail; clear target-lock and launch hints.

grenade.defects_found: Inventory art and generic effects obscured thrown motion and fuse feedback.
grenade.changes: Dedicated pin-and-lever sprite, slow tumbling, readable fuse and proportional blast.

cluster.defects_found: Parent and secondary projectiles shared a silhouette and split feedback was weak.
cluster.changes: Distinct shell and five small bomblets with inherited momentum, shrapnel burst and no secondary fuse badge.

sticky.defects_found: A body behind a wall could capture the attachment; final-tick motion could leave the blast behind its target.
sticky.changes: Terrain wins contact ties; attachment follows a living grub through the final fuse tick and releases on death/support loss.

dynamite.defects_found: Placement could cross a nearby wall or attach to the deploying grub.
dynamite.changes: Swept near-foot placement, shooter clearance, fixed four-second label/cue and sparks anchored to sprite rotation.

mega_bomb.defects_found: Heavy explosive used generic art and impact feedback.
mega_bomb.changes: Oversized bomb, rotating fuse sparks, heavy burst/smoke, bounded shake and explicit adjustable fuse.

banana.defects_found: Fruit and secondary fruit lacked distinct flight/split presentation.
banana.changes: Six smaller bananettes with inherited momentum and boosted damage, yellow burst and predicted split cue.

holy_bomb.defects_found: Expired airborne fuse could freeze the bomb; grand finale lacked a warning moment.
holy_bomb.changes: Continue falling until rest; one 18-tick chord/glow before a huge blast, bounded by 12 seconds; rest/chord badges.

poison.defects_found: Generic canister art failed to show leakage or a distinct cloud release.
poison.changes: Leaking canister with rotation-attached wisps, toxic bloom, clear fuse and release cue.

airstrike.defects_found: Drops appeared together; edge approaches could disappear; bomber vanished during zoom/rebuild.
airstrike.changes: Visible retained bomber from chosen side, five 0.4-second releases spanning about 152 px, edge-entry allowance.

mine_strike.defects_found: Dropped mines lacked a readable aircraft pass and landing feedback.
mine_strike.changes: Dedicated dropped mines from a staged bomber with landing cue and existing persistent arming behavior.

napalm.defects_found: Firebombs and their aerial approach used generic feedback.
napalm.changes: Dedicated firebombs, staged bomber, orange fire burst and bounded loose flames.
verification: both approach directions in shared strike tests

meteor.defects_found: Simultaneous rocks were hard to read; edge spawns could leave the map before impact.
meteor.changes: Six seeded staggered flaming rocks with fall-compensated spawns, fiery trails and rock bursts.

earthquake.defects_found: Tremor did not detach ropes or move loose props and lacked camera feedback.
earthquake.changes: Seeded rope-detaching grub/prop impulses, ground dust, heavy cue and bounded reduced-motion-aware shake.

shared_changes.lib/burrow/physics.rb: Terrain contact wins a simultaneous body overlap; delayed sky drops record on release and may enter from outside the map; choir keeps moving through fuse expiry; sticky attachment synchronizes on its terminal tick. Shared explode/crater/damage/impulse formulas are unchanged.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/match.rb: Projectile tracks append age/stuck and fragment identity; legacy live fragment tracks recover identity during restore. Existing checkpoint hashes/RNG persist new optional fields.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/client/timeline.rb: Consumes optional projectile identity/age/rest fields with legacy sample defaults. No deadline, elapsed-time, short-flight, history-pruning, or acknowledgement scheduling changes.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/client/scene.rb: Munition trails/fuse badges; bounded shake offset; one retained aircraft survives zoom/rebuild using playback time; clamp effect age at zero. Original fx_frames helper signature retained.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/client/camera.rb: Bounded decaying offset (8 px horizontal, 4.4 px vertical), inverse pointer transform, anchored zoom and reduced-motion cancellation; canonical pan/follow state remains unchanged.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/weapons.rb: Localized munitions: safe dynamite placement, staged sky drops, quake rope/prop impulses, fragment momentum/stage, poison/mine/choir feedback. gas_cloud accepts an optional weapon tag.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/client/audio.rb: Uses existing cues for munition fire/activation/choir/cloud/mine landing; activation prediction includes weapon identity and receipt deduplication remains in place.
shared_changes.lib/burrow/catalog.rb and lib/burrow/cli: Munition descriptions, hints, fixed-fuse labels and Fire labels; input acknowledgement and charge-source gating remain unchanged.
shared_changes.assets/art/manifest.json and tools/check: Declared stage variants and all 162 munitions frames; runtime canvas, raster scale, anchor, clipping and full coverage validation.
shared_changes.tools/weapon_lab.rb: Munition scripts plus additive isolated event/turn/ammo/projectile/hazard evidence; completed summaries persist after each weapon.
shared_changes.test/weapon_physics_test.rb: Prior resting-choir assertion now waits for the intentional 18-tick warning before detonation.
shared_changes.tools/check_action.rb and tools/check_ac: Action benchmark now measures visible rounded positions/camera after completed updates using check_rendering.py moving_intervals/frame_unix; gives Xvfb focus; retains .cache/native-action.raw.json. Fixes measured idle-gap false failures without changing budgets or game scheduling.

image_review.scope: Sprite atlas thumbnail plus one selected native frame thumbnail per weapon; no full-size frames/contact sheets opened.

art_rebuild.command: cd tools && nice -n 10 uv run build_art.py ordnance

weapon_lab.command: flock /tmp/burrow-bench.lock env SCARPE_DISPLAY_SERVICE=native SCARPE_NATIVE_HEADLESS=1 BURROW_LAB_WEAPONS="rocket mortar homing grenade cluster sticky dynamite mega_bomb banana holy_bomb poison airstrike mine_strike napalm meteor earthquake" BURROW_LAB_OUT=/tmp/munitions-lab ./bin/scarpe tools/weapon_lab.rb

action_first_attempt.result: failed with legacy velocity-based analysis; diagnosed as idle-gap false positives (see action_diagnosis)

action_second_attempt.result: failed with legacy velocity-based analysis; diagnosed as idle-gap false positives (see action_diagnosis)

action_diagnosis.conclusion: The original action checker demanded frames for 154 updates without any visible position changes. Replaying the existing rendering selector on the SAME capture passes; the 115.9 ms gap has zero visible movement. Action checker now shares that selector, samples completed updates, grants Xvfb focus, and retains raw evidence; numerical budgets are unchanged.
action_diagnosis.analysis_tests: python3 tools/test_rendering.py: 13 passed, including stalled GUI and pending-movement gap regressions
